CustomField.description: Date on or after which a time-restricted gift becomes eligible to be moved out of restricted funds. Blank means no time restriction. Interpretation is report-defined — no automatic release logic. On a payment against a commitment, this field defaults from the parent commitment but is independently writable — installments of a multi-year pledge may each carry their own release date. See .planning/fqs-designations-plan.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If the donor restricted this gift to a specific timeframe, enter the date on or after which the gift may be moved out of restricted net assets. Leave blank for purpose-only or permanently restricted gifts. On payments against a commitment, this defaults from the parent commitment.
CustomField.label: Restriction Release Date
